items.snippet:
Does SoloCam S340(T8170) support a memory card and motion-activated recording?
Yes, the SoloCam S340 comes with a built-in 8GB eMMC for local storage. The camera is designed to record when motion is detected. Even if the solar power fails, the camera will continue to record using its built-in battery until it runs out of power. If the WiFi connection is lost, the camera will still record and save

Why does SoloCam S340(T8170) sometimes miss recording events?
SoloCam S340(T8170) may miss events if the person/object is outside the Activity Zone but still in the camera's viewing area --- the system will not record in that case. Also: object may have exceeded the PIR detection range, or sensitivity is too low. Increase detection sensitivity and check the working mode.

Why has one of my SoloCam S340(T8170) cameras suddenly died?
1. Power Cycle the Camera**: - Remove the camera from its mounting. - Hold the sync button for 10-15 seconds to reset it. - Try reconnecting it to your HomeBase.
2. Check the Charging Status**: - Plug the camera into a charger and check for any LED lights. - If no lights appear, try a different charging cable and adapter.
3. Reconnect to

How do I reset SoloCam S340 (T8170) without the app?
To reset the SoloCam S340 (T8170) without the app, you can perform a hardware reset by pressing and holding the button on the camera for 15 seconds or more. This should reset the device to its default settings. However, please note that this method is typically used when the camera does not have any light effect indication, such as when it does

Is a subscription required to record video on SoloCam S340(T8170)?
No, SoloCam S340(T8170) does not require a subscription for recording. Footage is saved to the built-in 8GB storage or to a connected HomeBase. Note: Cloud storage is not supported.

Why does the microphone on SoloCam S340(T8170) not work on my Android device?
1. App Permissions:** - Go to phone settings → Apps → Anker eufy app → Permissions. - Ensure the app has permission to access the microphone.
2. Restart Your Devices:** - Restart both the SoloCam S340 and the Motorola Razr 2024. - Try reconnecting to see if the issue persists.
3. Network Connection:** - Ensure the camera

Does SoloCam S340(T8170) support 24/7 continuous recording?
No, SoloCam S340(T8170) does not support 24/7 continuous recording. It uses event-triggered recording to preserve battery life.

Why does the Power Source selection window disappear in the Anker eufy app for SoloCam S340(T8170)?
1. Update the Anker eufy app to the latest version.
2. Update the camera firmware to the latest version.
3. If the issue persists, contact eufy customer support with device SN and app version.

Why does SoloCam S340(T8170) only record the end of an event?
The object may have moved too fast or was at the edge of the detection zone. Solution: Increase Motion Detection sensitivity to extend detection range so events are detected earlier. You can also set a shorter detection interval in Customize Recording mode.

What happens if two SoloCam S340(T8170) cameras have the same name in Alexa or Google Assistant?
If two cameras have the same name, Alexa and Google Assistant cannot identify which one you are requesting. Please change one to a different, unique name.

Why won't SoloCam S340(T8170) connect to Bluetooth, show video on my phone, or send notifications for garden activity?
1. Check Network Connection**
- Ensure phone is connected to a stable Wi-Fi network, preferably 2.4GHz.
- Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data to see if the issue persists.
2. Reset the Camera**
- Press and hold the reset button for 10-15 seconds until a prompt is heard.
- Set up

Can I use continuous recording on SoloCam S340 (T8170)?
No, SoloCam S340 does not support 24x7 continuous recording.

Why does SoloCam S340(T8170) fail to return to its preset position after tracking?
1. Try Reset Device in the app and restart the device.
2. After completing the first setup, re-configure the preset position.
3. Ensure the camera firmware is updated to the latest version.
4. If the issue persists, contact eufy support with device SN and a video showing the problem.

Why is SoloCam S340(T8170) showing offline in the app?
1. Check the camera's battery level: If it is too low, charge the battery.
2. Check if the camera is switched off: Press and release the SYNC button. If the LED does not light up, set the camera to ON in the camera settings or press and hold the camera for 2 seconds to boot up.

1. Check the version of the Anker eufy app being used by going to Settings in the app, then About or App Information.
2. If using version 5.0 or higher, be aware that there may be known issues that the technical team is working to resolve.
